strategies.text: Dust Storm cuts the hit chance of everyone within 10 yards, so casters stay out of melee range; Tendon Rip slows the tank. Clear the nearby mobs first.
Terrifying Roar can fear players into grass packs: use a Tremor Totem or Fear Ward on the tank, or clear the grass first. Heavy bleed on the tank and an enrage at 20% health.
Entangling Roots and a self-heal. Avoid pulling the surrounding slimes and kill him fast.

Level 31, so more misses and dodges. Thunderclap slows attack speed, Arcing Smash is a frontal cleave, Knockaway cuts threat, War Stomp is an AoE knockback and stun (ranged stay away). It can be slowed and kited.

notes: Forever-only, single open floor: no uiMapID, use instanceMapID 2998. Level range is the client table (26-33; NeedRoll 24-29). Saltspine (lake), Shadetooth (raptor road) and the Relic Guardian (circular titan site) are estimates read off the map picture; Highland Horror has no position. No NPC or item IDs (no open source). NeedRoll was used only as a cross-check. Method: Highland Horror is Alliance-quest only (drops Horrible Rootcore); the Relic Guardian is level 31 and starts only after using the Titan Control Panel beside it; Titan Relic is its quest drop. Quest NPCs inside: the Relic Guardian itself (Lost Relic Carry for Alliance, Elder Knowledge for Horde).
